config_version.description: Visible version marker used for acceptance testing.

allowed_school_domains.description: JSON array of exact school email domains allowed to register.

allowed_test_emails.description: JSON array of exact non-school email addresses allowed for controlled testing.

service_fee_value.description: Service fee percentage or dollar amount, depending on type.

irs_mileage_rate.description: Backend-controlled cost-sharing mileage rate in USD per mile.

ride_share_base_url.description: Public browser URL used for externally shareable ride links.

max_route_detour_miles.description: Maximum pickup or drop-off distance from the driver's encoded route, in miles.

recurring_ride_occurrences.description: Number of weekly ride occurrences created when a driver enables repeat weekly.

pickup_dropoff_boundary_geojson.description: GeoJSON polygon exported from the client-approved Google My Maps pickup/drop-off boundary.

refund_rules_json.description: Ordered cancellation/refund tiers. Server code must enforce these when payments are implemented.

payment_expiration_hours.description: Hours an accepted request stays payable before expiring.

trip_auto_complete_hours.description: Backup trip auto-complete window after scheduled time.
